gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds a button that downloads a CSV export, and you are its author; robin and the team acme/reviewers are also asked to review it. The spec's CSV download and header format behaviors are covered, scheduled exports are deferred to acme/widgets#46, the export deliberately builds the whole CSV in memory instead of streaming it as the spec allows, and the export screen is handled in acme/export-ui.

Two problems block merging:

1. The exported file has no header row, so a spreadsheet opens the data without column names. The local test export_header in tests/export.test.mjs fails on this (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports only when clicked, so readers wait for a file that never arrives. A correction for the guide is drafted (docs/export.md:8).

Reviewer maria pointed out the missing header row, and she is right; a drafted reply thanks her and says the fix is planned. A required check named unit is still running; the build check passed in CI, and the local test run failed on the header test. Of the 3 items in your previous review, 2 are now addressed. The branch was rebased onto main, one conflict in src/export.ts was resolved along the way, and no commits were dropped. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the shared paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits can take it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have drafted repairs and this is your branch to push.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging code with the shared helper.
3. assess - post both problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - end the run and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
